title: Quake II 3.20 for Linux (SVGAlib) — id Software, with the 1998 demo's data
author: id Software, port by Dave 'Zoid' Kirsch
notes: id's Linux Quake II 3.20 (quake2-3.20-i386-unknown-linux2.0.tar.gz, libc5, from id's FTP) with Debian 1.3's libc5 and svgalib, on MIRAGE-LINUX: quake2 loads its SVGAlib renderer, ref_soft.so, and the game, gamei386.so, through ld.so's dlopen, from the directory /etc/quake2.conf names. Its data is the March 1998 demo's pak0.pak, taken from the Windows demo archive with the demo's licence beside it.
licenseName: id Software's Quake II demo licence (license.txt in the demo archive): free electronic redistribution with the licence
caution: The Quake II demo is id Software's, under its limited demo licence, not a free one: it may be passed on free of charge by electronic means, with its licence, for non-commercial use. MIRAGE never copies it: the page fetches id's archives unchanged.
